title: Business Development Executive (BDE)

Job description:

A Business Development Executive (BDE) for B2B sales—especially across FMCG and building materials—drives revenue by finding new corporate clients, managing channel partners like distributors or dealers, and meeting strict monthly sales targets.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation: Find new B2B clients, retailers, or channel partners via cold calls, market research, and networking.

Channel \& Account Management: Build relationships with distributors, wholesalers, and contractors to secure repeat business.

Pitching \& Presentations: Present product benefits and commercial proposals directly to clients, architects, or procurement teams.

Negotiation \& Closing: Negotiate pricing, credit terms, and delivery schedules to close profitable deals.

Market Tracking: Track competitor pricing, product trends, and regional demand. \[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]

Industry\-Specific Focus Areas

FMCG B2B: Focuses on primary and secondary sales, pushing volume through retail networks, managing stock inventory, and hitting fast\-moving consumer volume targets. \[1, 2]

Building Material B2B: Focuses on institutional sales, pitching to builders, contractors, and architects, or appointing regional stockists for cement, steel, or piping. \[1, 2]

Core Requirements

Education: Graduate degree or MBA in Sales and Marketing.

Experience: 1 to 4 years in B2B field sales or channel network expansion.

Skills: Strong negotiation, local travel readiness, relationship building, and clear communication.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: Sales Co-ordinator and CRM
company: Progressive Tools and Components Pvt Ltd.
description:
Here’s a professional and detailed Job Description for a Sales Coordinator / CRM Executive focused on handling B2B Tier 2 and OEM component manufacturers for sheet metal engineered components:

Job Title:

Sales Coordinator / CRM Executive (B2B \& OEM – Sheet Metal Components

Job Summary:

The Sales Coordinator / CRM Executive will play a key role in supporting the sales team by managing customer relationships, coordinating order processing, and ensuring seamless communication between clients, production, and logistics. The candidate will primarily handle B2B Tier 2 customers and OEM component manufacturers within the sheet metal and engineered components industry, ensuring timely delivery, accurate documentation, and superior client satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Customer Relationship Management (CRM):

* Serve as the primary point of contact for Tier 2 and OEM clients.
* Maintain and update CRM databases with customer information, inquiries, and communication logs.
* Build long\-term relationships with clients to promote repeat business and customer loyalty.
* Coordinate with the sales team to follow up on leads, quotations, and pending orders.

2\. Sales Coordination

* Prepare and issue quotations, proforma invoices, and sales orders in coordination with sales and production teams.
* Track order status from quotation to dispatch, ensuring adherence to customer delivery schedules.
* Liaise with the production, planning, and logistics departments to ensure customer requirements are met.
* Monitor pricing, margins, and contract terms to ensure compliance with company policies.

3\. OEM / B2B Client Management:

* Handle key accounts in Tier 2 and OEM segments, ensuring technical and commercial alignment.
* Understand client requirements for sheet metal and engineered components, including specifications, tolerances, and drawings.
* Coordinate with engineering and design teams for new product development or sample submissions.
* Support in vendor registration processes, audits, and documentation for OEMs.

4\. Reporting \& Analysis:

* Maintain sales trackers, order status reports, and forecast summaries.
* Generate CRM reports and analyze sales trends, customer performance, and pipeline health.
* Support management in developing pricing strategies and sales forecasts.

5\. Documentation \& Communication:

* Manage and verify all sales\-related documentation including PO, invoices, and dispatch details.
* Ensure timely communication of order confirmations, production updates, and delivery schedules to clients.
* Assist in preparing presentations, proposals, and tender documentation as needed.

Qualifications \& Experience:

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical / Industrial / Production Engineering, Business Administration, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in sales coordination or CRM in a manufacturing / engineering / automotive components company.
* Familiarity with sheet metal fabrication, press parts, or engineered component manufacturing preferred.
* Experience working with Tier 2 suppliers or OEM clients is highly desirable.

Skills \& Competencies:

* Strong understanding of B2B sales cycles and industrial procurement processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in MS Office, ERP/CRM software (e.g., SAP, Zoho, Salesforce).
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Technical aptitude to understand component drawings and specifications.
* Customer\-oriented mindset with problem\-solving skills.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* On\-time order processing and delivery coordination.
* Accuracy of CRM data and reporting.
* Customer satisfaction and retention rates.
* Responsiveness and follow\-up efficiency.
* Sales pipeline visibility and support effectiveness.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Description – Front Desk Executive**

**Position:** Front Desk Executive  
**Industry:** Real Estate  
**Department:** Administration / Front Desk Executive  
**Location:** Vaishali  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a professional, well\-groomed, and customer\-oriented **Front Desk Executive** with experience in the **Real Estate industry**. The candidate will be responsible for managing the reception area, handling visitors and calls, coordinating with clients, and providing administrative support to ensure smooth day\-to\-day front\-office operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the front desk and reception area professionally.
* Greet and welcome clients, customers, visitors, and business associates.
* Handle incoming and outgoing calls and direct them to the appropriate department.
* Coordinate with the **Sales, CRM, and Project/Site teams** for client requirements and appointments.
* Schedule and manage meetings, appointments, and site visits.
* Maintain visitor records, call logs, and other front\-office registers.
* Handle basic client follow\-ups and coordinate with the concerned sales/CRM executive.
* Maintain records of walk\-in clients and ensure proper lead information is captured.
* Assist the sales team in managing walk\-in customers and initial project inquiries.
* Coordinate refreshments and meeting arrangements for clients and visitors.
* Support administrative activities and other office coordination as required.
* Ensure the reception area is clean, organized, and presentable at all times.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and client information.

**Real Estate\-Specific Responsibilities**

* Handle **walk\-in clients and property/project inquiries**.
* Record and maintain details of prospective customers and leads.
* Coordinate **site visit appointments** with the sales/site team.
* Provide basic information about ongoing projects, locations, amenities, and available services as instructed.
* Coordinate with the CRM/Sales team regarding client visits and follow\-ups.
* Maintain daily records of walk\-ins, calls, inquiries, and site visits.
* Assist in collecting and organizing basic customer documents when required.

**Required Skills**

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good telephone etiquette and customer\-handling skills.
* Professional personality and presentable appearance.
* Basic knowledge of **real estate projects and customer handling**.
* Good coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, Excel, and email communication.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Good Hindi and English communication skills.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

**Qualification**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* Prior experience in **Real Estate / Property / Construction / Builder industry** will be preferred.

**Key Performance Areas (KRA)**

* Professional handling of visitors and clients.
* Call and visitor management.
* Walk\-in lead generation and accurate data recording.
* Client communication and follow\-up coordination.
